question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **first**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"first"** means something that comes before all others in time, order, or importance. (पहला)
 
• **"First" **is used to denote the position that is before any other in a sequence or order. (पहला)
 
 
• **Example: **He finished first in the race.
 
 
 
• The context tells us not to extend our hand first when we are seated with a group of people during dinner.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3 is **"first"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **first**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **second **(दूसरा): Coming after the first in time or order.

 
 
• **Example:** She won second place in the competition.
 
 
 
• **last **(अंतिम): Coming after all others in time or order.
 
 
• **Example: **He was the last to leave the office.
 
 
 
• **end** (अंत): The final part of something.
 
 
• **Example:** They reached the end of the road.
